name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells with an underhand palms-forward grip.
Soften your knees and hinge forward with a flat back until your arms hang beneath your shoulders.
Drive your elbows back close to your sides until the dumbbells reach beside your lower ribs.
Squeeze your back briefly, then lower the dumbbells under control until your arms hang straight.
tips: Keep your torso still without standing upright as you pull.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid rounding your lower back during the hinge.
